summary: Judge an unbackticked `*.md` page name as a citation, and spell the 37 src/ sites repo-relative so the path arm answers them

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: An unbackticked `*.md` token in a `src/`/`harness/` comment is judged by the existing path and placeholder rules; every page name those comments carry is spelled repo-relative, sits in the repo pin's judged set, and none dangle.
tests: the citation scan judges an unbackticked *.md page name in a comment
the citation scan judges no unbackticked *.md name carrying a path placeholder
the repo citation pin judges the unbackticked page names src/ comments carry
notes: Ruled at a331e06: a page name is a reference backticked or not. 37 sites, all in `src/`, all of the form `(engineering.md "Section")` — spelled repo-relative in place and left unbackticked, so the widened arm judges them rather than emptying. Placeholders (`<ISO-timestamp>--<tag>--reverted.md`) fall out on the existing `PATH_SEGMENT` charset; string literals are not comments and stay out.
